comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Rare treasure chest drop from Chapter 3: Pharos. Japanese name translates as "Thunderer Revolver" - Thunderer is one of three (unofficial) names applied to the Colt M1877 so it's probably related to that model. Handgun/revolver-type weapon, obviously.

Source: tinyurl.com/UWO-7WondersPharos-3
